verdict.rationale: Reflect has no in-app plugin system. Community users explicitly praise it for being fully functional without plugins. What developers do get is a documented public REST API: OAuth 2 with PKCE, a curl example, and an OpenAPI 3.0 spec covering graphs, links, daily-note appends, note creation and the current user. Deep-link URL commands are also documented. Together these let developers build external clients and integrations, but not true plugins, and note contents can't be read through the API because of end-to-end encryption. Missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension API or SDK, plugin samples and developer guides, read access to note content, versioning/deprecation policy, sandbox/test environment.
